question: The classical text, Hasthalakshana Deepika, is associated with which Indian classical dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kathakali.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Hasthalakshana Deepika is a text that is associated with the Indian classical dance form of Kathakali.**

 
 
• It is a manual that provides a detailed description of the mudras or hand gestures used in Kathakali, along with their meanings and usage.
 
• The text is believed to have been written by a scholar named Karthikeya Muni, who was a disciple of the famous Kathakali exponent, Kaplingad Narayanan Namboodiri.
 
• The term 'Hasthalakshana' literally means 'characteristics of the hand', and the text is considered to be an important reference guide for students and practitioners of Kathakali.
